name: manual_e38bd5
claim: Do not claim a milestone from a feature PRs green checks alone: qualify the final merged, immutable pins with fresh-install, compatibility-cell, and crash-recovery evidence, keep capability-dependent tests in explicit bands, and issue a dated receipt only after the full matrix is complete.

decisions.notes: T2/M1 review: PR #36 test cells are valuable prerequisite evidence, but they do not replace the outstanding production-install, final-pin compatibility, and crash-recovery qualification. The production Core pin lacks start markers, so the start-seam tests must be collected only in the capability band that supports them; M1 remains unclaimed until the final receipt.
